997-1445-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2079-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2079-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2403-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2026-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4779-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4779-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

3951-4875-5703-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4875-5703-8095.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-997-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-997-7936.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1558-6758-7839.notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-6758-7839.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating 100 Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

876-4667-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Elvish Aberration.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Elvish Aberration.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Elvish Aberration.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Elvish Aberration from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6747-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6747-7750.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
3532-5078-6747-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1274-3641-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3641-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3220-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6705-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

394-1445-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-4871-6797.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4231-4321-5777.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.
4094-4231-4321-5777.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

1020-3689-6518-6709.notablePrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1020-3689-6518-6709.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

579-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
579-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
579-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

225-880-6662.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
225-880-6662.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Chocobo Racetrack and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2438-4053--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-4053--73.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-4053--73.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

1267-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Medomai the Ageless token.
During the combat phase of your extra turn, declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-2457-5223-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5223-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1651-4259-4659-5184.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1164-1721-2793-3743.notablePrerequisites:
Osgir does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in exile.
1164-1721-2793-3743.description:
Activate Osgir's second ability by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating two token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Exile one of the Ugin's Nexus copies due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Osgir's first ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the remaining Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Osgir ability, giving a creature you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your first extra turn.
If you do not control a Mirror of Fate token, activate Osgir's second ability by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Mirror of Fate from your graveyard, creating two token copies of Mirror of Fate.
Activate a Mirror of Fate token by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Ugin's Nexus, any other card in exile, Mirror of Fate and up to four other cards in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top in the aforementioned order.
Activate Codex Shredder's first ability by tapping it, causing you to mill Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your second extra turn.
Activate Codex Shredder's first ability by tapping it, causing you to mill Mirror of Fate.
Repeat.

2-1057-3169-4659.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber triggers.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Myr and Incubator, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-1847-2577-3918.notablePrerequisites:
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
1636-1847-2577-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Golden Throne's ability by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

933-957-2493.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
